I traced the error in the bridge logs — there was a stale token entry for StratusAI that wasn't rotated during the last migration; Zoom returns the token-expired page when the token reference doesn't map to an active session. I'll do the following now:
- Regenerate a fresh join token for the org and push a replacement meeting URL
- Re-issue a clean .ics with the correct organizer/UID so Outlook clients won't treat it as an orphaned invite
- Upload trace to the ticket (attached)

ETA: 25 minutes. If Rachel or Marissa can push a Meet link in the interim that's best to avoid delaying the demo.
